title: Head of Corporate Development: Weighting challenge
notice: Demo with sample data only. It is not connected to your organization's data, and it should not be.
question: Does the ranking hold if we weight financial quality more heavily?

answer.question: Does the ranking hold if we weight financial quality more heavily?
answer.answer:
Yes — the ranking holds. Lumenrock stays #1 across all three weighting schemes (base thesis, financial-first, equal weights).

One thing to watch: under financial-first weighting, the gap between #2 (Tessaline Controls) and #3 (Veridane Analytics) shrinks from 2.8 points to just 0.7 — so those two are essentially tied if financial quality matters most to you. Worth digging into their evidence before leaning too hard on that ordering. Want me to pull the evidence gaps for those two?
